rawFindings.title: Incorrect URL regex in error formatter breaks source map URL matching
rawFindings.explanation: The change replaces the URL_REGEXP regex from optional HTTP and domain patterns to a stricter pattern that always expects 'http://'+domain+slash. This removes matching URLs that do not include the protocol/domain part, which is common in stack traces (e.g., relative URLs like '/base/foo.js:line:column'). As a result, source maps may not be correctly applied to error stack traces, leading to inaccurate error file/line reporting.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original regex to correctly match URLs optionally with protocol and domain, allowing relative URLs to be source-mapped properly.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Stack trace input containing relative URLs like 'at /base/b.js:2:6' will not have source map applied and show unprocessed paths instead of original sources.
